The two candidate figures are far apart, so I am checking the 2015 school-fight statistic for Chinese students aged 13–15 before choosing.As of 2015, 19% of children aged 13–15 in China reported being in a physical fight at school one or more times during the past 12 months. That level matches school-based youth surveys for this age group in China, which place past-year physical fighting in the mid-to-high teens.

CONFIDENCE: 74
